concept.name: Idempotency & Message Deduplication
concept.tagline: Make retries safe with idempotency keys, dedupe stores, and exactly-once effects at the business layer.

spark.summary: At-least-once delivery is the practical default; idempotent handlers and deduplication tables turn duplicate deliveries into harmless no-ops.
spark.keyTakeaway: Design every externally visible side effect to be idempotent or keyed—retries are not edge cases, they are the transport model.

concept.whyItMatters: Payment double-charges, duplicate shipments, and poison retries are almost always missing idempotency boundaries.
whenNotToUse: Pure read-only queries with no side effects
keyPoints: Dedupe window must exceed max retry horizon
Outbox pairs DB write with publish intent

examples.title: Payment capture API
examples.outcome: Same idempotency key returns original receipt instead of double billing.

failureModes.name: Key collision
failureModes.description: Different operations reuse the same idempotency key.
failureModes.mitigation: Scope keys per operation type and principal.

commonMistakes: Using only database unique constraints without application-level keys

deepDive.markdownContent:
## Safe retries

Transport is at-least-once; business logic must be idempotent.

caseStudy.solution: Dedupe table keyed by event id

relationships.description: Outbox publishing pairs with idempotent consumers.
